title: Cardinality of an odd frequency extension member
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let $i$ be an index in an $n$-element set, and let $S$ belong to the family formed by adjoining $i$ to each $m$-element subset of the other indices. Then $i\in S$ and $|S|=m+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index in an $n$-element set
$S$ belongs to the specified extension family
